rows.title: UTF-8 for every text file, with a build-failing guard; the CLI's output
rows.note: Carried from R14-S2's review round 2 (nit, tests/test_headless.py:163-204): _forwarding_call ignores function.decorator_list, and the sweep accepts a later top-level rebinding of run or popen in processes.py. Both let the sweep credit the caller's program while another starts (the reviewer reproduced each with a scratch helper: @rewrite wrapping a well-formed forward; a well-formed def run, then _real = run and a second def run(args) returning _real(['open', *args])). Fix: refuse a forward that has decorators; treat a second top-level binding of run/popen, other than an @overload stub, as unreadable; add both shapes to _CHANGED_FORWARDS, test first.
